notes.title: The Lilliput Workshop is OUT NOW! With a Special "Complete the Set" Bundle!
notes.content: [p]Hello, everyone![/p][p]We are thrilled to announce that [i]The Lilliput Workshop[/i] has officially launched on Steam today![/p][p]To celebrate this moment, we have teamed up with the creators of [i]Reviver[/i] and [i]Sunset Hills[/i] to offer a special "Complete the Set" bundle. notes.title: We're Joining The Days of Ramadan Festival 2025!
notes.content:
Dear Friends,

Get ready! We're thrilled to announce that we'll be participating in the 2025 Steam Days of Ramadan Festival, running from February 28th at 02:00 GMT+8 to March 31st, 2025, at 02:00 GMT+8!

The 2025 Steam Days of Ramadan Festival marks a first-of-its-kind event, bringing together indie game developers from around the globe for a Ramadan-themed sale. It's a fantastic opportunity for indie devs and game lovers to connect, share ideas, and celebrate Ramadan together.

During the festival, feel free to check out and play the latest games and grab some awesome discounts from across Asia! We hope you have a blast!

notes.title: Our Heartwarming New Title《Reviver》launches on January 9th!
notes.content:
Greetings, everyone!

Mark your calendars! Reviver, our latest creation, launches on Steam January 9th! 
Prepare to be swept away by a narrative puzzle game weaving together romance, time travel, and destiny.ːDaisySHOCKː

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2239130

Reviver represents a departure for CottonGame, delving deeper into storytelling and offering richer, more extensive text than our previous titles. 
Experience a poignant love story that spans a lifetime, from youthful exuberance to the golden years.ːDaisyGJː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840735/db25d6651fd574b60f5501f48c11ee1ebd0f648f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840735/2f05e8c683fa9dfbddb7cd2729e94e86d27c3ec6.jpg[/img]

True to its name, Reviver embraces the butterfly effect as its core mechanic. 
Your choices, made across different eras, ripple through time, dramatically altering the narrative's course. 
Avert disastrous outcomes with seemingly small decisions, rewriting fate itself!ːtobdogː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840735/dbd843e213fee95b6db599b520b3780a2b66a57a.png[/img]

ːsteammockingːNaturally, we've retained the signature CottonGame brain-teasing puzzles you've come to expect. 
To complement this, we've sprinkled in a variety of engaging minigames, offering delightful diversions throughout your journey.

Intrigued? Wishlist Reviver now to be notified the moment it releases!ːSpeech_Loveː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840735/c91cbeaecc20dc24d9b40b2b26cde418be6edb24.png[/img]
Stay tuned – more exciting news is on the horizon!

Warmly,ːSpeech_Loveː
CottonGame

notes.title: ✨Our latest demo will be featured in Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Hello, dear player!

During the [b]Steam Next Fest[/b] this October, from October 14th to 21st, we are excited to bring you the latest demo from The Lilliput Workshop. You can enjoy playing to your heart's content this time!

[h2][b]If you like it, please add the game to your wishlist![/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42536836/a4563960258f71fc5059673416ec8dd8dddc68a8.png[/img]

This demo has fixed previous bugs and improved the gaming experience. We've also added comprehensive English localization, significantly enhancing the overall quality of the game. 

We highly recommend you download and give it a try! There will be more surprises in store for you, including the latest news on our game's release, improvements, new platform updates, and more.

Your feedback and support are our greatest motivation. Thank you so much for your continued support. We are dedicated to bringing you the best content and look forward to moving forward together with you.

Cotton Game

notes.title: 🌟 《The Liliput Workshop》New Demo Live Now! Join Our Prize-Winning Event🌟
notes.content:
Hello Gamers!

Exciting news— 《The Liliput Workshop》will join the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/wholesomegames]Wholesome Games Celebration[/url][/b] from August 15th-21st! Celebrate games that bring joy and introspection.

[h2]What's in Store?[/h2]

Try our [b]new demo[/b], featuring enhanced prologue and fresh chapter one content. We've listened to your feedback and can't wait for you to see the improvements!
Participants providing feedback will have a chance to win exclusive gifts.

[h2]Your Feedback Matters![/h2]

Play the demo and help us develop. Your insights are crucial!

[h2]Event Details[/h2]

Event Period: August 15th, 1 PM PT - August 22nd, 1 PM PT
How to Participate: Play the demo and share anything related to Woolly Boy And The Circus on X or Discord and tag us!

X: @[url=https://x.com/CottonStudio]CottonStudio[/url]
Discord: [url=https://discord.com/invite/mrrXbVU2ut]Cotton Games[/url]

Prizes: We'll randomly select 6 lucky guys from X and Discord participants
Prizes Include: Steam Keys for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1182090/_/]Mr. Pumpkin 2: Kowloon Walled City[/url]

[h2]Other Cotton Games Recommendation[/h2]

Don't miss out on other Cotton Games like [b]Sunset Hills[/b], gearing up for offically launching.
[b]Before Fate[/b], [b]Reviver[/b] and [b]Woolly Boy And The Circus[/b] are on the way!

[h2]Support and Follow[/h2]

Subscribe《The Liliput Workshop》and add us to your wishlist for the latest updates and festival perks!

Thanks for your support! See you at the festival!

Cheers,

The Liliput Workshop Team

notes.title: “力力普的工坊”正在参与「东方游戏文化周」活动！
notes.content:
Hi 大家好，

“力力普的工坊”很高兴的宣布，我们正在参与由蒸汽平台主办的「东方游戏文化周」活动！
在「东方游戏文化周」活动期间，将配合本次活动推出“力力普的工坊”试玩版Demo，提供广大玩家进行免费试玩体验。
试玩版demo中玩家可以使用各种零件组装出一套轨道系统，引导小火车把特定形状的积木块运送到目的地，完成任务。

“力力普的工坊”期待在「东方游戏文化周」活动与各位热爱游戏的鉴赏家们相遇。
